description.zh: aeval 的宿主侧 Cordis 控制插件：一次性配置注入器（实验变量、网关租约预算、分叉谱系、Bundle 描述符），并提供独立的状态模式。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness custom wallpaper plugin: pick a local image as background in the Settings panel, adjust opacity, blur, UI transparency and dimming, with instant preview.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自定义壁纸插件：在设置面板中选择本地图片作为背景，可调节不透明度、模糊、界面通透度和压暗，并即时预览。

description.en: Full-featured Mem0 integration for DSH: auto-recall, consolidation, 7 tools, influence scores, provenance, and a trace viewer.
description.zh: DSH 的完整 Mem0 集成：自动召回、记忆整合、7 个工具、影响力评分、来源追溯及调用链查看器。

description.en: Load only basic DeepSeek Harness tools by default and activate other tools on demand.
description.zh: 默认仅加载基础 DeepSeek Harness 工具，其他工具按需激活。

description.en: Tavily web search for DSH (keyless or keyed, official DeepSeek when off), plus the Tavily MCP: search, extract, crawl, map and research.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Tavily 网页搜索（可无 Key 或使用 Key；关闭时为官方 DeepSeek），并集成 Tavily MCP：搜索、提取、爬取、站点映射与研究。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: OpenCode GO plan quota widget in the sidebar, same-origin usage proxy, and a /opencode-go chat command
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：侧边栏中的 OpenCode GO 套餐额度小组件、同源用量代理，以及 /opencode-go 聊天命令。

description.en: Adds macOS- and Windows-style interfaces, theme colors, wallpaper and font settings to DeepSeek Harness, plus a Blue Whale desktop pet that can be toggled independently.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 macOS 与 Windows 风格界面、主题配色、壁纸和字体设置，以及可独立开关的蓝鲸桌宠。

description.en: Tailscale remote access operations panel for DeepSeek Harness: health checks, HTTPS ingress toggle, macOS proxy bypass, relay server operations, and ACL snippet generation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Tailscale 远程访问运营面板：健康检查、HTTPS 入口开关、macOS 代理绕过、中继服务器运维、ACL 片段生成。

description.en: Checks 三重一大 decision ledgers against prior research, meeting deliberation and resolution records; flags differences only, with no qualitative conclusions.
description.zh: 依据前置研究、会议审议与决议记录程序，核对“三重一大”决策台账并留痕；仅提示差异，不作定性结论。

description.en: Checks repair-order settlement arithmetic: confirms that project amounts, parts and labor hours, and the settlement total are internally consistent; flags differences only, with no qualitative conclusions.
description.zh: 核对维修工单结算算术：核查项目金额、配件与工时合计及结算总额是否内部自洽；仅提示差异，不作定性结论。

description.en: Context7 MCP for DeepSeek Harness: up-to-date library documentation and code examples.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Context7 MCP：提供最新的库文档与代码示例。

description.en: Firecrawl MCP for DeepSeek Harness: web crawling, scraping, search, and structured data extraction
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Firecrawl MCP：网页爬取、抓取、搜索和结构化数据提取

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin bundling the kimi-ppt skill: create, edit and export PPT slides and presentations as local .pptx files with Pillow-rendered previews.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，内置 kimi-ppt 技能：在本地创建、编辑并导出 PPT、幻灯片与演示文稿（.pptx），并用 Pillow 渲染预览。

description.en: Media library for the dsh web UI: browse configured local directories as a grid or list, open images in a viewer, and play videos in a page-fullscreen player with swipe navigation.
description.zh: dsh Web UI 的媒体库：以网格或列表浏览已配置的本地目录，在查看器中打开图片，并在页面全屏播放器中播放视频，支持滑动切换。

description.en: Use logged-in web AI services (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Doubao, etc.) as model providers in DeepSeek Harness. Web models emit tool calls, and DSH runs them under its native permission system.
description.zh: 将已登录的网页版 AI（DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、Qwen、豆包等）作为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型提供方。网页模型输出工具调用，由 DSH 通过其原生权限系统执行。

description.en: Plugin for the A6API multi-model aggregator: native LLM provider registration, live account balance and price-change monitoring, token allowlist sync, merchant route probing, and a panoramic metrics card.
description.zh: A6API 多模型聚合站接入插件：原生 LLM 供应商注册、账户实时余额与价格波动监控、Token 白名单同步、商户线路探测及全景指标卡片。

description.en: Unified subscription providers and usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一订阅供应商与用量看板。

description.en: Universal MCP Apps host and UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的通用 MCP 应用宿主与 UI 插件。

description.en: Ollama bundle: configures the ollama provider for llm-pi-ai and sets web_search to use the Ollama backend, including provider selection in the web row, all in one go.
description.zh: Ollama 一套配置：一次性配置 llm-pi-ai 的 ollama 供应商，并让 web_search 使用 Ollama 后端（含网页行的供应商选择）。

description.en: Third-party macOS menu bar activity indicator for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 macOS 菜单栏活动指示器。

description.en: Automatically connects models included in the WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
description.zh: 无需任何配置，将 WorkBuddy 桌面应用中包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: DSH image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image via Volcano Ark Seedream (Doubao). Zero dependencies, pure JavaScript, no build step.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 生图插件：基于火山方舟 Seedream（豆包）的文生图 / 图片生成。零依赖，纯 JavaScript，无需构建。

description.en: Scheduled task dispatcher: a dsh host plugin that runs recurring agent tasks from a single task table, dispatching each run as an independent dsh session.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：dsh 宿主插件，基于单一任务表驱动周期性代理任务，每次运行都作为独立的 dsh 会话派发。

description.en: Weir: an orchestrator-centric DSH agent preset with an intent gate, category delegation, a todo driver, pull-based background jobs, auto-compaction, and hashline editing.
description.zh: Weir：以编排器为核心的 DSH 智能体预设，包含意图门控、类别委派、待办驱动、基于拉取的后台任务、自动压缩与 hashline 编辑。

description.en: Escape from Tarkov themed plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a hero beta-warning banner, translucent looping video background, background music dock, and event sound effects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的《逃离塔科夫》主题插件：顶部测试版警告横幅、半透明循环视频背景、背景音乐停靠栏和事件音效。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API balance and this conversation's spend in the Harness web UI: a persistent balance pill beside the composer, with details on hover.
description.zh: 在 Harness 网页界面中显示 DeepSeek API 余额及本次对话消耗：输入框旁的常驻余额胶囊，悬停可展开明细。

description.en: Literature search for DeepSeek Harness using the official PubMed NCBI E-utilities API (esearch, esummary, efetch, elink) and Google Scholar via SerpApi or direct HTML parsing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文献检索：基于 PubMed NCBI 官方 E-utilities API（esearch/esummary/efetch/elink）以及 Google Scholar（通过 SerpApi 或直接解析 HTML）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: an agent-safe EVM wallet with an encrypted vault, signing policy, model tools, a bundled skill, and a web UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：面向智能体安全使用的 EVM 钱包，包含加密保险库、签名策略、模型工具、内置技能及网页界面。

description.en: Drives local Origin/OriginPro from chat: imports data, plots, fits, exports images and saves editable .opju projects; 27 MCP tools. Third-party, unaffiliated with OriginLab.
description.zh: 在对话中驱动本机 Origin / OriginPro：导入数据、绘图、拟合、导出图片，并保存可在 Origin 中继续编辑的 .opju 工程；共 27 个 MCP 工具。第三方工具，与 OriginLab Corporation 无关联、未获其认可。

description.en: DSH plugin: start and stop a local llama.cpp llama-server from Settings → Plugins, with two model slots (A/B), per-slot model-file selection, and eight editable launch parameters.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在“设置 → 插件”页面启动或停止本地 llama.cpp 的 llama-server，提供 A/B 两个模型槽位，每个槽位可单独选择模型文件，并可编辑八项启动参数。

description.en: Six features in one bundle, including a transparent, always-on-top desktop pet from codex-pets.net and a global wallpaper from wallhaven.cc or a local image.
description.zh: 一个包内含六项功能，包括来自 codex-pets.net 市场的透明置顶桌面宠物，以及来自 wallhaven.cc 市场或本地图片的全局壁纸。

description.en: An Obsidian side-panel math memory agent for DeepSeek Harness. It offers layered long-term memory, an idea memo with proactive review reminders, and unified note_recall retrieval with note tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Obsidian 侧边面板数学记忆智能体，提供分层长期记忆、带主动复习提醒的灵感备忘，以及统一的 note_recall 检索与笔记工具。

description.en: A full-featured CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) provider plugin.
description.zh: 功能完整的 CodeBuddy（WorkBuddy）提供方插件。

description.en: Git Commit: commit workspace changes from the conversation header, with model-planned commit groups.
description.zh: Git 提交：从对话标题栏提交工作区变更，提交分组由模型规划。

description.en: DSH memory panel: browse, search, edit, and delete memories in Settings, and manually start or stop the local vector service.
description.zh: DSH 记忆面板：在设置页中浏览、搜索、编辑和删除记忆，并可手动启停本地向量服务。

description.en: Provides the current Web instance's tokenized access URL to the model and shell via DSH_WEB_AUTH_URL, resolved on each shell call, plus a cookie-jar usage note. Secrets stay out of prompts and transcripts.
description.zh: 通过 DSH_WEB_AUTH_URL 将当前 Web 实例的带 token 访问地址提供给模型和 Shell，每次 Shell 调用时即时解析（随重启后的 token 轮换而更新），并补充一段 cookie jar 用法说明。secret 不进入提示词与 transcript。

description.en: Fullscreen lightbox for chat images with zoom, pan, download and paging, a thumbnail grid with adjustable columns, TIFF/HEIC transcoding, and an image-delivery rule.
description.zh: 对话中的图片值得细看：全屏灯箱（缩放、拖拽平移、下载、左右翻页），可调列数的缩略图网格，TIFF/HEIC 自动无损转码，并内置“图片投递”规则，确保图片写入回复正文而不是折叠的工具行。

description.en: Official A-share data API plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 31 tools covering quotes, K-lines, financials, sectors and backtesting; free tools need no key.
description.zh: A股数据 API 官方 DeepSeek Harness 插件：提供 31 个 A股工具，涵盖行情、K线、财务、板块与量化回测等；免费工具无需 Key。

description.en: Adds an Environment Check tab in Settings showing host process identity and grouped env vars (values stay on the host), plus a read-only env_inspect model tool.
description.zh: 环境体检：在“设置”中新增分页，展示宿主进程身份与环境变量分组（值不出宿主），并为模型提供只读的 env_inspect 工具。

description.en: dsh plugin: encrypted backup, restore and migration of the dsh home config through a private GitHub repo.
description.zh: dsh 插件：通过私有 GitHub 仓库对 dsh 主目录配置进行加密备份、恢复与迁移。

description.en: Escalation-only LLM reviewer: reviews sandbox escapes only, keeps the sandbox, fails closed.
description.zh: 仅用于升级的 LLM 审查器：只审查沙箱逃逸行为，保持沙箱不变，失败时封闭（fail closed）。

description.en: Unified web search for the DeepSeek Harness seam (ctx.web): DeepSeek (official), Tavily, Brave, Serper, SerpApi, Exa, SearXNG, Scavio, and Firecrawl backends
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 统一网页搜索接口（ctx.web）的后端支持：DeepSeek（官方）、Tavily、Brave、Serper、SerpApi、Exa、SearXNG、Scavio 和 Firecrawl。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Claude Code-style prompt history with Up/Down navigation, a double-Esc history search picker, and selection quote/copy with right-click paste.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：Claude Code 风格的上下键历史回溯、双击 Esc 历史搜索、选中文字引用与复制，以及右键粘贴。

description.en: One-call Conventional Commits Git workflow for DeepSeek Harness at zero token cost: generates commit messages for each changed file, splits them into commits by type(scope), pushes once, and asks about tagging when needed.
description.zh: 零 Token 的 Git 提交推送插件：一次调用完成，按 Conventional Commits 为每个变更文件自动生成提交信息，按 type(scope) 拆分多次提交后一次推送，必要时询问是否打标签。

description.en: Multi-host SSH tunnel and SSHManager tool for DeepSeek Harness, with project-scoped grants.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多主机 SSH 隧道与 SSHManager 工具，授权按项目划分。

description.en: DSH Web Git Sidebar: VS Code-style left-rail Git panel for DeepSeek Harness with branch switching, commit graph, per-commit previews and a session-following footer entry.
description.zh: DSH Web Git 侧边栏：仿 VS Code 风格的左侧 Git 面板，支持分支切换、提交图谱、逐次提交预览，以及跟随会话的页脚入口。

description.en: Lets the DeepSeek Harness web composer accept folders via drag, paste or the /folder command, with a host folder dialog and @path mentions.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框支持拖入或粘贴文件夹，并提供宿主文件夹对话框、/folder 命令及 @path 提及。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: shows what the OpenRouter account actually charged today, per chat and in total, under the composer and in Settings, split by model and API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：显示 OpenRouter 账户今日实际扣费，包括每个对话与总计，位于输入框下方及设置页，并按模型与 API Key 拆分。

description.en: Balance monitor for third-party services in DeepSeek Harness: enter an API key and check remaining quota every 1 to 30 minutes, with a dashboard and sidebar status icon. Supports Tavily, Bocha, Firecrawl, SerpAPI, SearchApi, ScrapingBee, ScraperAPI, and TinyFish.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 第三方服务余额监控：录入 API Key，按 1/5/10/30 分钟定时查询剩余额度，提供主面板看板与侧边栏状态图标。支持 Tavily、博查、Firecrawl、SerpAPI、SearchApi、ScrapingBee、ScraperAPI、TinyFish。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页插件：在网页配置成功启动后运行用户自定义的命令。

description.en: Ark models, web-search tools and Web UI in one bundle
description.zh: 方舟模型、网页搜索工具与 Web UI 集成于一个插件包。

description.en: Multi2API account pool: turns multiple WorkBuddy accounts into separate, non-interfering models in DSH.
description.zh: Multi2API 账号池：把多个 WorkBuddy 账号变成 DSH 里一个个互不干扰的模型。

description.en: Semantic workspace search plugin for DSH (zg): zg_search, zg_index, and zg_status, plus a local embedding settings card, systemPrompt routing rules, and a guard safety net.
description.zh: DSH 工作区语义检索插件（zg）：提供 zg_search、zg_index、zg_status 工具，以及本地 embedding 设置卡片、systemPrompt 路由规则和 guard 安全兜底。

description.en: Permanently deletes a DeepSeek Harness conversation and all its local data: session log, derived caches, workspace index entries, spill files, and unreferenced attachments.
description.zh: 永久删除 DeepSeek Harness 对话及其所有本地数据：会话日志、派生缓存、工作区索引条目、溢出文件以及未被引用的附件。

description.en: Load, edit, manage and hot-reload trusted JavaScript and TypeScript userscripts in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中加载、编辑、管理可信的 JavaScript 与 TypeScript 用户脚本，并支持热重载。

description.en: DSH plugin: one uniform frosted-glass material for the UI surfaces, plus an optional image or video dynamic wallpaper behind them.
description.zh: DSH 插件：为界面表面提供统一的磨砂玻璃材质，并可在其后设置图片或视频动态壁纸。

description.en: Set image input and reasoning levels for third-party provider models.
description.zh: 为第三方提供商模型设置图片输入与推理强度等级。

description.en: Review a change set as a relationship graph in the middle column, with every node clickable to the exact source line.
description.zh: 在中间栏以关系图形式审阅变更集，每个节点都可点击跳转到对应源码行。

description.en: Exposes this machine's DSH web GUI to a chosen CIDR range, such as Tailscale, on DSH 0.2.1+. It can require an optional numeric access code and provides a phone layout that applies only to remote pages.
description.zh: 在 DSH 0.2.1+ 中将本机 DSH 网页界面开放给指定 CIDR 网段（如 Tailscale），可选数字访问码，并提供仅作用于远程页面的手机布局。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) host plugin: the model draws vector figures inline between reply paragraphs, so answers read as text, figure, text.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）宿主插件：模型在回复段落之间插入矢量图示，使回答呈现为文字-图示-文字的结构，而非大段文字。

description.en: Sidekick: persistent Lead–Sidekick collaboration. Delegate bounded tasks, then accept or send back exact results.
description.zh: Sidekick：持久的 Lead–Sidekick 协作。委派有界任务，然后接受或退回精确结果。

description.en: DSH plugin: inventory your Windows dev/test toolchain, spot the gaps, and fill them with one click.
description.zh: DSH 插件：盘点 Windows 开发与测试工具链，找出缺失项，并可一键补齐。

description.en: Jizuo Video: standalone video projects, novel-adaptation scripts, and video editing.
description.zh: 即作视频：独立视频项目、小说改编剧本与视频编辑。

description.en: Release Console adds a DeepSeek Harness sidebar entry and main-panel page showing each repository's builds and releases. It flags whether local checkouts are ahead or installed copies are outdated.
description.zh: 发布台（Release Console）：DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏入口与主面板页面，展示各仓库的构建与发布情况，标示本地检出是否领先，以及本配置中安装的副本是否过时。

description.en: Kingdee Cloud Starry Sky secondary-development plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): typed tools over the Kingdee Cloud WebAPI, credential-safe config, and a companion domain skill.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的金蝶云星空二次开发插件：基于金蝶云 WebAPI 的类型化工具、凭据安全的配置，以及配套的领域技能。

description.en: Image bridge: connects external image-generation models to models without image generation or editing abilities. Configure the API and key in the web interface, and the model can call image generation and editing directly.
description.zh: 生图桥：给没有生图/修图能力的模型接入外部生图模型。在 Web 界面配置 API 与 Key，模型即可直接调用生图/改图能力。

description.en: Human-in-the-loop gate for DSH tool calls: mount any tool behind an approve, modify or reject decision card in the DSH web UI, with an optional countdown.
description.zh: DSH 工具调用的人在回路（Human-in-the-loop）关卡：可将任意工具置于审批、修改或拒绝的决策卡片之后，并可选倒计时。

description.en: Image generation tool and settings page for DeepSeek Harness, working with any OpenAI-compatible /images/generations endpoint.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的图像生成工具与设置页，可对接任何兼容 OpenAI 的 /images/generations 接口。

description.en: Media models: standalone image and video model configuration, plus chat generation tools.
description.zh: 媒体模型：独立图片与视频模型配置、聊天生成工具

description.en: dsh plugin: an unattended approval gate. Subagent, scheduled and cron approval requests get a bounded answer window, then settle on a fail-closed default instead of hanging.
description.zh: dsh 插件：无人值守审批关卡。subagent、定时任务及 cron 的审批请求会在有限的答复时间窗口内等待，超时后按失败即关闭（fail closed）的默认值结算，而不会无限挂起。

description.en: Chain-of-thought keyword counting and highlighting with per-word count chips, a click-to-suppress switch, per-word colours, text colour and size, and whole-word matching.
description.zh: 思维链关键词计数与高亮：支持每个词的计数标签（点击可屏蔽）、每词颜色、文字颜色与字号，以及全词匹配。

description.en: Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, using the official Notion MCP with no integration token.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 在图形界面中连接 Notion，使用官方 Notion MCP，无需集成令牌。

description.en: DSH toolbox bundle: one plugin installs five features, each with its own switch: delete conversations, regenerate from here, the /teammate command, cross-session reminders, and auto-naming after the first turn. The plugin page shows one card with five component rows.
description.zh: DSH 工具箱（装配包）：一个插件装好五个功能，每项可独立开关：删除对话、重新生成（从这里重来）、队友命令（/teammate）、跨会话提醒，以及首轮结束后自动命名。插件页呈现为 1 张卡片加 5 行组件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness browser provider: reads a page as an indexed action space, then runs one guarded operation at a time.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 浏览器供应商：将页面读取为带索引的操作空间，然后每次仅执行一项受保护的操作。

description.en: Favorites, copy id and path, per-session delete, idle batch archive and a favorites filter for DSH conversations, as additive extensions to the shipped archive feature.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话提供收藏、复制 id 与路径、按会话删除、空闲时批量归档及收藏筛选，作为对已有归档功能的增量扩展。

description.en: DSH plugin: inventories your Windows dev/test toolchain, spots the gaps, and fills them with one click.
description.zh: DSH 插件：盘点你的 Windows 开发与测试工具链，找出缺失项，并一键补齐。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness helpers that add 11 UI languages, a Changes panel, input history, Shift+Tab /plan, one-click Continue, and chat resumption after restart. They also add queue drag-and-drop and deeplinks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 辅助功能：新增 11 种界面语言、变更面板、输入历史、Shift+Tab /plan、一键继续，以及重启后恢复运行中的会话，并支持队列拖拽排序与深度链接。

description.en: Browse, search, and install SkillHub skills inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、搜索并安装 SkillHub 技能。

description.en: DSH plugin: SSH remote ops and dev toolkit (run/read/write/edit/glob/grep/push/pull), ControlMaster connection layer, status panel, and host management in Settings.
description.zh: DSH 插件：SSH 远程运维/开发工具套件（run/read/write/edit/glob/grep/push/pull），包含 ControlMaster 连接层、状态面板，以及设置页中的主机管理。

description.en: Password gate: when DSH opens, a password screen appears first, and the app is usable only after unlocking. Supports manual and automatic locking, with passwords stored as one-way scrypt hashes.
description.zh: 密码门禁：打开 DSH 时先显示密码界面，解锁后才能使用；支持手动锁定与自动锁定，密码以 scrypt 单向哈希存储。

description.en: Turns DSH's settings dialog into a Codex-style full-page fullscreen settings page for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的设置弹窗改成 Codex 风格的整页全屏设置页。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer, just above the account entry.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部、账户入口上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: DSH developer tools: Git panel and startup management, as a manifest bundle where each component is its own package.
description.zh: DSH 开发工具：Git 面板与启动管理（清单包，各组件独立成包）。

description.en: Native token-based themes for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with custom colors and system font pickers.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供基于设计令牌的原生主题，支持自定义颜色和系统字体选择。

description.en: Right-sidebar media preview for inline video, audio and HTML, plus a folder gallery where selected media can be added to the video workspace canvas. Works in DSH's sidebar and in dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 右侧栏媒体预览：直接预览视频、音频和 HTML（大文件可拖动进度条，HTML 默认允许脚本），以及文件夹媒体画廊（多选后加入影视工作台画布）；可用于 DSH 自带右侧栏，安装 dsh-better-sidebar 后也可使用。

description.en: Google Vertex AI provider for DeepSeek Harness: service-account auth for Google-hosted Claude and Gemini models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Google Vertex AI 提供商：通过服务账号认证，支持 Google 托管的 Claude 与 Gemini 模型。

description.en: Weixin (personal WeChat, iLink Bot API) channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness: command a DSH agent from WeChat, with support for images, files, and voice-note transcription.
description.zh: Weixin（个人微信，iLink Bot API）渠道插件：在微信中指挥 DSH 智能体，支持图片、文件和语音转写。

description.en: Whale-girl desktop pet for DSH web that mirrors session status, with zone hotspots, feeding, drag, emoji bubbles, a token/cost dashboard, XP and titles, and optional proactive companionship.
description.zh: 住在 DSH Web 中的鲸鱼娘桌宠：镜像会话状态，支持分区热区、拖拽、喂食、表情气泡、Token/费用仪表板、XP/称号养成和可关闭的主动陪伴。

description.en: Immersive theme for Arknights players on the DSH Web GUI: twelve full-screen wallpapers with edge blur adapted to each image, glass and text colors computed per image, a Rhodes Island icon system, and signature-style authorization and selection interactions.
description.zh: 为《明日方舟》玩家打造的 DSH 网页界面沉浸式主题：12 张整屏壁纸（按画面自适应边缘虚化）、按每张图计算的玻璃与文字颜色、罗德岛图标体系，以及签字式的授权与选择交互。

description.en: DSH plugin: configure per-model reasoning effort levels for custom pi-ai providers in the Models settings page, with presets for GPT, Claude, Grok, GLM and MiMo models.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在模型设置页为自定义 pi-ai 提供方配置每个模型的推理强度级别，并内置 GPT、Claude、Grok、GLM 和 MiMo 模型的预设。

description.en: Lingxi (灵犀) for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a desktop cat that reacts to the mood of the work, with five model tools (task, say, react, state, remember) over the pet bridge, plus settings.
description.zh: 灵犀（Lingxi）为 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）打造的桌面小猫，会根据工作状态做出反应；通过宠物桥接提供五个模型工具（task/say/react/state/remember）及设置。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that shows the CNY cost of each completed turn. It uses per-model cache-hit/miss, cache-write, and output rates, with weekly peak-valley multipliers and promos.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件，在每个已完成的回合下方显示人民币费用，依据各模型的缓存命中/未命中、缓存写入与输出单价计算，并考虑每周峰谷倍率与限时促销。

description.en: Git branch and worktree management: shows and switches the current branch in the input toolbar, with an IDEA-style branch picker, remote checkout, right-click actions, push/update, and isolated worktree workspaces.
description.zh: Git 分支与 worktree 管理：输入框工具栏显示并可原地切换当前分支；支持 IDEA 风格分支选择器、远程分支检出、右键操作菜单（新建/重命名/删除/复制）、推送与更新当前分支，以及将分支隔离到独立 worktree 工作区并管理其创建与删除。

description.en: DSH image generation plugin backed by a local ComfyUI server, exposing one unified generate_image tool (text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, background removal).
description.zh: DSH 图片生成插件：基于本地 ComfyUI 服务，只对外暴露一个统一的 generate_image 工具（文生图、图生图、局部重绘、背景移除）。

description.en: Japanese locale pack for the DSH Web GUI: registers 日本語 and provides ja dictionaries for all dsh-web-all family plugin namespaces.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面日语语言包：在共享语言目录中注册日本語，并为 dsh-web-all 系列所有插件命名空间提供 ja 词典。

description.en: Ctrl+wheel page zoom for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with an on-screen zoom chip and a General settings row.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面支持 Ctrl+滚轮缩放页面，并提供屏幕缩放提示标签与“通用”设置项。

description.en: QQ Mail for the DSH right sidebar: read recent mail and send plain text with a confirm gate. Credentials are read only from a private secret.json.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 QQ 邮箱：读取最近邮件、查看正文，发送纯文本邮件需经确认。凭据仅从私有 secret.json 读取，不进 git、不入日志、不回显。

description.en: The /cron command for DeepSeek Harness: runs a prompt on a cron expression or plain-English schedule, parsed in code, with the model as a last resort.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 /cron 命令：按 cron 表达式或自然语言时间安排运行提示词，优先由代码解析，最后才交给模型。

description.en: Hosts a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge that exposes every model configured in DSH to Midscene browser automation. Midscene can drive pages in natural language without holding any credential itself.
description.zh: 在本机回环地址运行 OpenAI 兼容桥接，将 DSH 中配置的所有模型（官方路由、插件路由及用户声明的供应商）提供给 Midscene 浏览器自动化，后者无需持有任何凭据即可用自然语言操控页面。

description.en: DSH plugin: delete an archived session's local files (transcript, projection cache and its subagent sessions) after a two-step confirmation.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在两步确认后，删除已归档会话的本地文件（对话记录、投影缓存及其 subagent 会话）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding two code-quality skills: /simplify (behavior-preserving cleanups of the current diff) and /code-review (multi-angle review).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，新增两个代码质量技能：/simplify（对当前 diff 做保持行为不变的清理）与 /code-review（多角度代码审查）。

description.en: Leafy: an eye-friendly green skin that folds the DSH Web GUI's --dsw-* palette into leafy greens, in both light and dark modes.
description.zh: Leafy：护眼的绿色皮肤，将 DSH 网页界面的 --dsw-* 配色收拢为叶绿色调，同时支持浅色与深色模式。

description.en: ZPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness, with durable API-key settings and CLI configuration.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 ZPDF 工具，支持持久化的 API Key 设置与命令行配置。

description.en: Better Sidebar for DSH: file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, kept separate per conversation, plus a service other plugins use to register sidebar items.
description.zh: DSH 的增强侧边栏：在同一列中提供文件树、编辑器、变更、任务与侧边聊天，并为每个对话独立保存；同时对外提供服务，供其他插件注册侧边栏项。

description.en: Lets the agent drive DSH's built-in browser in the right sidebar's Browser tab: list tabs, open and navigate pages, read content, run JavaScript, click, fill forms, and log in.
description.zh: 让代理操控 DSH 内置浏览器（右侧栏的浏览器标签页）：列出标签页、打开和导航页面、读取内容、执行 JavaScript、点击、填写表单、登录等。

description.en: The core Japanese locale pack for the DSH Web GUI. It registers Japanese and provides ja dictionaries for every DSH core plugin namespace, independent of dsh-i18n-ja, with English fallback for missing keys.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面日语语言包（核心）：注册日语，并为所有 DSH 核心插件命名空间提供 ja 词典。独立于 dsh-i18n-ja，缺失的键回退为英文。

description.en: Media panel in the DSH right sidebar: downloads Douyin/YouTube links with yt-dlp, converts audio to 16 kHz mono WAV with ffmpeg, and transcribes it with the official speechToText (SenseVoice) for subtitles and agent summaries.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的媒体面板：将抖音/YouTube 链接交给本机 yt-dlp 下载，用 ffmpeg 转为 16k 单声道 WAV，再由官方 speechToText（SenseVoice）转写，字幕显示在面板中，Agent 可一键总结。

description.en: Daily journal and calendar for DeepSeek Harness: the journal_record tool appends one JSON file per day, and the right sidebar draws it as a calendar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的每日日记与日历：journal_record 工具每天追加一个 JSON 文件，右侧栏将其绘制为日历。

description.en: Multi-directory workspaces for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多目录工作区。

description.en: Links pet-whale and dsh-whale-widget: when the desk pet nears the widget it pretends to work and turns toward it, and the widget greets it with a default bubble, without modifying either plugin's source.
description.zh: 连接 pet-whale 与 dsh-whale-widget：桌宠靠近挂件时进入「假装工作」状态并转身面向挂件；挂件扫到桌宠时用默认气泡播放一段默认文字（不修改两个前置插件的源文件）。

description.en: General usage stats for DeepSeek Harness: throughput, tokens, cost, tool calls, and activity, charted in the Web UI. A TypeScript superset of dsh-plugin-tokspeed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用使用统计：吞吐量、Token、费用、工具调用与活动，在网页界面中以图表展示。是 dsh-plugin-tokspeed 的 TypeScript 超集。

description.en: WeChat (iLink / ClawBot) channel for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的微信（iLink / ClawBot）渠道

description.en: Mark DSH sidebar conversations with a tinted background, a colored dot at the row's end, and a per-conversation title size.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏对话添加着色背景、行末彩色圆点，并可为每个对话设置标题字号。

description.en: BuilderHUD — vitals-cluster skins for the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: BuilderHUD：用于 DSH 侧边栏的生命体征式皮肤。

description.en: Git tools and /git slash commands for DeepSeek Harness, running git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work even when the session shell is sandboxed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工具与 /git 斜杠命令，在宿主进程中运行 git，即使会话 Shell 处于沙箱中，push、pull 和 fetch 也能正常工作。

description.en: Exposes DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web capabilities to the Xiaozhi voice assistant over MCP, as a self-contained bundle that registers DSH as an MCP tool provider and supports multiple devices.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 能力开放给小智语音助手：自包含的 DSH 插件包，将 DSH 注册为 MCP 工具提供方，支持多设备。

description.en: OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面中的 OpenViking：Studio 面板、按会话显示的记忆提交状态胶囊及其提交时间线，以及展示当前会话检索内容的右侧栏标签页。

description.en: Gotify notifications when DSH session turns end: a host and browser plugin bundle, configurable in the Settings UI.
description.zh: DSH 会话轮次结束时的 Gotify 通知插件：宿主与浏览器插件包，可在设置界面中配置。

description.en: Con's auto review (DCAR): a DeepSeek Harness tool review plugin that applies deterministic rules first and escalates to an LLM on demand, with a CAutoR permission mode.
description.zh: Con's 自动审查（DCAR）：确定性规则优先、LLM 按需升级的 DeepSeek Harness 工具审查插件，提供 CAutoR 权限模式。

description.en: Shows a Gemini quota bar in the DeepSeek Harness composer; clicking it opens a multi-account pool panel with per-account remaining quota, cooldown start/stop, keep-alive detection, and one-click account switching.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框显示 Gemini 额度条，点开即为多账号池面板：逐账号查看剩余额度、启停冷却、检测保活，并可一键切换账号。

description.en: Balance and spending of an arckep.ru account inside the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI. Unofficial community plugin.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页界面中显示 arckep.ru 账户的余额与消费。非官方社区插件。

description.en: Desktop notifications when a DeepSeek Harness turn ends: bundled Python/PowerShell notifier, custom command fallback, and its own Settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 轮次结束时发送桌面通知：内置 Python/PowerShell 通知器，支持自定义命令回退，并提供独立的设置页。

description.en: Cursor-style AI code workbench for DSH: file tree, tabbed editing, syntax highlighting, quote/translate tags for the AI, docked or floating layout.
description.zh: Cursor 风格的 AI 代码编辑器工作台插件（DSH）：文件树、多标签页编辑、语法高亮、可将引用/翻译内联标签提供给 AI，并支持右侧停靠或悬浮窗口双布局。

description.en: Shows oversized images to the model at a readable high resolution by tiling them before admission.
description.zh: 在接收前将超大图片分块，以清晰的高分辨率展示给模型。

description.en: Moves the in-car radio from godot_citys into the DSH right sidebar: a three.js in-car view, winding night roads, and radio-browser internet stations (City Pop).
description.zh: 将 godot_citys 中的车载电台搬进 DSH 右侧栏：three.js 车内视角、蜿蜒的夜路，以及 radio-browser 网络电台（City Pop）。

description.en: Centrally manages environment variables injected into the host, with allowlisted hot reload for plugins that read them only at startup (such as dsh-sql).
description.zh: 集中管理注入宿主的环境变量，并支持按白名单热重载那些启动时只读一次环境变量的插件（如 dsh-sql），免重启即可读取新值。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: aligns the Markdown pipe tables touched by each write or edit, and reports what changed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工具包：对每次写入或编辑涉及的 Markdown 管道表格进行对齐，并报告所做的更改。

description.en: DSH bundle: push Bark notifications to iPhone and Apple Watch when an agent finishes a run, needs approval, or errors out.
description.zh: DSH 插件包：代理运行结束、需要审批或出错时，向 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 推送 Bark 通知。

description.en: Pando desktop pet for the DSH UI, a replica of the confirmo.love companion with a local sprite directory and community sprites. Drag to move and right-click to switch sprites.
description.zh: DSH 界面的 Pando 桌面宠物，复刻 confirmo.love 陪伴角色，支持本地精灵图目录和社区精灵图。拖动移动，右键切换精灵图。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: the DeepSeek API account balance, shown beside Settings at the sidebar foot.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏底部设置按钮旁显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness pill showing whether the selected DeepSeek or z.ai billing plan is in a peak or off-peak (half-price) window right now, with a click-to-open schedule panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 状态胶囊，显示当前所选 DeepSeek 或 z.ai 计费方案处于高峰还是低谷（半价）时段，点击可打开时段表。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin wrapper that registers the domestic trip-planner-cn Agent Skill in the DSH skill catalog, so after installation you can load SKILL.md and its references, scripts, and themes resources by name.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件外壳：将境内旅行规划智能体技能（trip-planner-cn）注册到 DSH 技能目录，安装后即可按名称加载 SKILL.md 及其 references、scripts、themes 资源。

description.en: Shows provider API balance and subscription quotas as an always-visible dsh Web sidebar card, or the original composer pill, for the provider behind the model used in this conversation.
description.zh: 以始终可见的 dsh Web 侧边栏卡片（或原有输入框胶囊）显示服务商 API 余额与订阅额度，即当前会话所用模型对应服务商的余额。

description.en: Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness, where the model writes the interface in DIL (Markdown, JSX-like tags, JavaScript). The host compiles it, and a sandboxed runtime renders interactive text and rich cards.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 智能 UI：模型以 DIL（Markdown + 类 JSX 标签 + JavaScript）编写界面，宿主编译后由沙箱化客户端运行时渲染为交互文本与富卡片。

description.en: Ledger for the DSH right sidebar: log entries (amount, category, note), view monthly totals and category stats; data stays local, and the agent can read and write via ledger_panel.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的记账本：记录一笔（金额、分类、备注），查看本月支出、收入与结余，并按分类统计；数据全部保存在本地，Agent 也可通过 ledger_panel 工具读写。

description.en: General-purpose calendar for the DSH right sidebar: month view with date selection, a list of the day's events, and today and week overviews; events are stored locally, and the agent can read and write via calendar_panel.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的通用日历：支持月视图点选、当日事件列表及今日/本周一览；事件存储在插件本地，Agent 也可通过 calendar_panel 工具读写。

description.en: Settings page for the DSH web GUI's MCP servers: a JSON editor over a profile-config namespace that mounts live mcp-client instances from the saved servers.
description.zh: dsh 网页界面的 MCP 服务器设置页：通过 JSON 编辑器编辑配置命名空间，并根据已保存的服务器挂载实时的 mcp-client 实例。

description.en: Injects a small continuity pointer when a new session starts; if there is no handoff document, it prefers reusing the previous session's compaction summary.
description.zh: 新会话开始时注入一条简短的接续指针；若没有交接文档，则优先复用上一会话的压缩摘要。

description.en: Pomodoro timer for the DSH right sidebar: 25-minute focus and 5-minute break cycles, timed on the host; the agent can read status and start or stop it via pomodoro_panel.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的番茄钟：25 分钟专注与 5 分钟休息循环，计时在宿主侧运行，切换标签页或关闭面板都不会停止；Agent 也可通过 pomodoro_panel 工具读取状态并启停。

description.en: Calorie diary for the DSH right sidebar: a built-in food table auto-computes kcal from grams, logs by meal, and shows daily totals and goal progress; the agent can read and write via calorie_panel.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的卡路里日记：内置常见食物热量表，选择食物与克数即可自动计算千卡，按餐次记录，并查看当日合计与目标进度；数据存于本地，Agent 也可通过 calorie_panel 工具读写。

description.en: IRC client in DSH's right sidebar: the host connects to IRC directly via Node tls/net (or optionally through a local proxy's HTTP CONNECT tunnel), and agents can also read and send messages via the irc_panel tool.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 IRC 客户端：宿主通过 Node tls/net 直连 IRC（也可选择经本机代理的 HTTP CONNECT 隧道），在右侧栏收发消息，Agent 也能通过 irc_panel 工具读取和发送消息。

description.en: Lightweight to-do list for the DSH right sidebar: one item per line, check off to complete, collapsible completed items; stored locally, and the agent can add, check and delete via todo_panel.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的轻量待办：每行一项，勾选即完成，已完成项可折叠；数据存于本地，Agent 也可通过 todo_panel 工具添加、勾选与删除。

description.en: Finance terminal for the DSH right sidebar: cross-asset quotes, a rotating globe, a risk-appetite gauge, plain-Chinese explanations and related news, with two-way chat with the agent via finance_panel.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的金融终端：跨资产行情、旋转地球、风险偏好读数、中文说明与相关资讯，并可通过 finance_panel 工具与 Agent 双向对话。

description.en: RSS reader for the DSH right sidebar: feeds are set in config, entries sorted by time, with mark read and favorite; the host fetches via the local proxy.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 RSS 阅读器：订阅源在配置中设置，条目按时间排序，可标记已读或收藏；由宿主抓取，经本机代理访问。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop theme for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI — visual & interaction overhaul
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web GUI 的 Claude Code Desktop 主题，全面改进视觉与交互。

description.en: Pomodoro timer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a full sidebar page with focus, short-break, and long-break cycles, plus a countdown pill beside the composer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的番茄钟：侧边栏整页提供专注、短休息、长休息循环，输入框旁显示倒计时胶囊。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and per-session usage cost in the Harness composer dock.
description.zh: 在 Harness 输入框停靠区显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与每个会话的用量费用。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one Feishu topic maps to one dsh session, with in-card approvals and questions over a long connection that needs no public endpoint.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的飞书/Lark 桥接：一个飞书话题对应一个 dsh 会话，支持卡片内审批和提问，通过长连接工作，无需公网端点。

description.en: Save completed conversations as Markdown memories and provide retrieval and long-term memory consolidation.
description.zh: 将完成的对话保存为 Markdown 记忆，提供检索和长期记忆整理。

description.en: Run single-turn or continuing questions in an independent subagent and display the results in the current conversation.
description.zh: 在独立子 Agent 中进行单轮或连续问答，并把结果展示在当前对话中。

description.en: Consult TypeSafe Jev before a turn to suggest whether a registered agent should handle the task.
description.zh: 在回合开始前咨询 TypeSafe Jev，建议是否把任务交给已注册的 Agent。

description.en: Deliver bounded tasks to online agents using calendar or interval schedules.
description.zh: 按日历或间隔规则，把有执行边界的任务投递给在线 Agent。

description.en: Apply bounded retries to transient gateway failures such as EOF, TLS alerts and stream read errors.
description.zh: 对 EOF、TLS 告警和流读取失败等网关瞬态错误进行有界重试。

description.en: Use environment proxies and an undici dispatcher to route model traffic through configured proxies.
description.zh: 结合环境代理和 undici 路由，为模型请求配置代理与分流。

description.en: Add timeline navigation, folders, prompts, export, Mermaid, quoted replies, appearance controls and usage displays.
description.zh: 提供时间线、文件夹、提示词、导出、Mermaid、引用回复、外观设置和用量显示。

description.en: Record model token usage and estimated costs, then query historical statistics from Settings.
description.zh: 记录模型 Token 用量和费用估算，在设置页查询历史统计。

description.en: Zoom individual web panels with Ctrl+wheel or keyboard shortcuts and reset each panel independently.
description.zh: 通过 Ctrl 加滚轮或快捷键独立缩放网页面板，并分别恢复默认大小。

description.en: Authorize FlowUs through browser OAuth and expose its official MCP tools as native agent tools.
description.zh: 通过浏览器 OAuth 授权 FlowUs，把官方 MCP 工具接为 Agent 原生工具。

description.en: Create skills through configured creator backends, score the results and request revisions below the quality threshold.
description.zh: 通过配置的创建后端生成技能，对结果评分，未达质量阈值时要求继续修改。

description.en: Create and modify Blender scenes, import models, and preview or export images and video.
description.zh: 创建和修改 Blender 场景、导入模型，并预览或导出图片与视频。

description.en: Connect Qoder models with PAT credentials, regional account pools, check-ins, automatic rotation and credit display.
description.zh: 通过 PAT 接入 Qoder 模型，支持分区域账号池、签到、自动换号和积分显示。

description.en: Search DBLP and arXiv, retrieve BibTeX citations and access available paper full text.
description.zh: 检索 DBLP 和 arXiv，获取 BibTeX 引用及可用的论文全文。

description.en: Use an interactive terminal interface with tables, charts, Mermaid diagrams and side conversations.
description.zh: 提供交互式终端界面，支持表格、图表、Mermaid 和旁支会话。

description.en: Manage local novel projects, revision history and writing presets from a sidebar workbench.
description.zh: 在侧边工作台管理本地小说项目、修订记录和创作预设。

description.en: Recall experience strategies before tasks and record evaluations from checks and later feedback.
description.zh: 在任务前召回经验策略，根据检查结果和后续反馈记录评价。

description.en: Run board or list tasks through DSH sessions and sync their status in host-side storage.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 会话执行看板或清单中的任务，把状态回写到宿主端共享存储。

description.en: Restart or upgrade DSH, inspect runtime health, and manage backups and Linux permissions from a web panel.
description.zh: 在网页面板中重启或升级 DSH、查看运行状态，并管理备份和 Linux 权限。

description.en: Export and import session packages, relocate workspaces and sessions, and synchronize them between machines.
description.zh: 导入导出会话包，迁移工作区与会话目录，并在机器之间同步会话。

description.en: Manage global or project skills and MCP servers, and inspect the tools exposed by each server.
description.zh: 管理全局或项目级技能与 MCP 服务器，并查看服务器提供的工具。

description.en: Rewrite the composer draft through an auxiliary model, or request a command result without changing the draft.
description.zh: 通过辅助模型改写输入框草稿，也可用命令查看结果而不修改草稿。

description.en: Withdraw turns from the visible conversation and model context while preserving logs and quarantining affected file changes.
description.zh: 让撤回回合退出界面和模型上下文，保留日志，并把相关文件改动放入隔离区。

description.en: Read official DSH documentation in the plugin page and search docs or npm metadata with native tools.
description.zh: 在插件页阅读 DSH 官方文档，并用原生工具检索文档和 npm 元数据。

description.en: Browse and install community plugins, skins and pets from the web interface.
description.zh: 在网页界面浏览并安装社区插件、皮肤和宠物。

description.en: Download, register, disable and uninstall community agent presets from the Workshop.
description.zh: 在工坊中下载、注册、停用和卸载社区 Agent 预设。

description.en: Synchronize GitHub Issues with a task board in the DSH web interface.
description.zh: 把 GitHub Issues 同步到 DSH 网页任务看板。

description.en: Delete sessions and their owned subagents from the interface or a tool, stopping running sessions and clearing stored artifacts.
description.zh: 从界面或工具删除会话及其拥有的子 Agent，会先停止运行会话并清理存储产物。

description.en: Apply allow and deny rules plus a classifier before tool execution to handle permission approvals.
description.zh: 在工具执行前结合允许、拒绝规则和分类器处理权限审批。

description.en: Download, browse and edit files through the browser when DSH runs in a container without local filesystem access.
description.zh: 当 DSH 运行在无法访问本地文件的容器中时，通过浏览器下载、浏览和编辑文件。

description.en: Generate images, video, music and speech through multiple providers, with transcription and visual analysis tools.
description.zh: 接入多家供应商生成图片、视频、音乐和语音，并提供转写与视觉分析工具。

description.en: Manage MCP server configuration, startup, reconnection and tool switches, and import JSON configurations.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器配置、启停、重连和工具开关，并导入 JSON 配置。

description.en: Store project pitfalls and reusable practices in separate volumes, with monotonic identifiers and synchronized indexes.
description.zh: 按分册保存项目踩坑与可复用做法，使用只增不改的编号并同步索引。

description.en: Review tool calls using global and project rules, with categorized approvals, inline diffs and sandbox escalation handling.
description.zh: 结合全局与项目规则审查工具调用，提供分类审批、内联差异和沙箱升级处理。

description.en: Use skills to guide engineering tasks through the harness and agent loop.
description.zh: 以技能驱动 Harness 与 Agent 循环，组织工程任务的执行流程。

description.en: Render model-authored openui-lang programs as editable lists, tables, charts, controls and drawings in chat.
description.zh: 把模型生成的 openui-lang 程序渲染为对话中的可编辑列表、表格、图表、控件和绘图。

description.en: Translate selected text using public translation endpoints or a model configured in the current harness.
description.zh: 划选文字后，通过公共翻译接口或当前 Harness 已配置的模型翻译。

description.en: View local AI usage and optionally submit anonymous data to a rolling seven-day ranking.
description.zh: 查看本地 AI 用量，并可选择匿名参与近七日用量排行。

description.en: Inspect visible skills and their sources, read SKILL.md, manage invocation permissions, and create or soft-delete skills.
description.zh: 查看会话可见技能与来源、阅读 SKILL.md、管理调用权限，并创建或软删除技能。

description.en: View desktop usage, provider quotas and custom queries, with optional WorkBuddy credits and an extended model selector.
description.zh: 查看桌面用量、供应商配额与自定义查询，可选 WorkBuddy 积分和扩展模型选择器。

description.en: Switch installed skins and edit each skin's options from Settings.
description.zh: 在设置页切换已安装的皮肤，并调整各皮肤自带的选项。

description.en: Apply a black-whale theme with square corners, straight-line icons and light and dark palettes.
description.zh: 提供黑鲸主题、直角界面、线条图标及明暗配色。

description.en: Add unread-delivery indicators and popup notifications to the native automation task interface.
description.zh: 为原生自动化任务界面增加未读投递标记和弹出通知。

description.en: Capture conversation excerpts or new notes, organize them with tags and search, and manage trash and backups.
description.zh: 摘录会话或新建笔记，用标签整理和搜索，并管理回收站与备份。

description.en: Connect CodeBuddy models through browser OAuth, with account switching, model capabilities and quota display.
description.zh: 通过浏览器 OAuth 接入 CodeBuddy 模型，支持账号切换、模型能力查看和额度显示。

description.en: Read and write WPS 365 cloud documents through the local CLI, with conflict checks before writes; requires an enterprise account.
description.zh: 通过本机 CLI 读写 WPS 365 云文档，写入前检查并发冲突，需要企业版账号。

description.en: Query A-share prices, financials, announcements and news, then organize analysis and charts.
description.zh: 查询 A 股行情、财务数据、公告和新闻，并整理分析与图表。

description.en: Search online skill catalogs, install skills into user or project directories and manage local skills.
description.zh: 搜索在线技能目录，把技能安装到用户或项目目录，并管理本地技能。

description.en: Save reusable prompts and shell commands globally or per workspace, then run them from session controls.
description.zh: 把提示词和 Shell 命令保存为全局或工作区运行配置，从会话入口执行。

description.en: Replace stock shell and file tools with persistent Bash, structured reads, multiple edit modes and atomic writes.
description.zh: 以持久 Bash、结构化读取、多模式编辑、原子写入和安全删除替换基础工具。

description.en: Connect steps on a canvas and compile the graph into a dispatch plan for the model to execute.
description.zh: 在画布上连接步骤，把流程图编译为交给模型执行的派发计划。

description.en: Adjust conversation fonts, font sizes, line spacing and horizontal margins.
description.zh: 调整对话字体、字号、行间距和水平留白。

description.en: Start a local WorkBuddy Panel backend with DSH and sync selected backend models into a provider.
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动本地 WorkBuddy Panel 后端，并把选定后端模型同步为模型提供方。

description.en: Start a local OpenCode2API backend with DSH and manage backend releases from Settings on Windows.
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动本地 OpenCode2API 后端，适用于 Windows，并在插件设置页管理后端版本。

description.en: Provide a Tavily backend for web search, with credential storage, key rotation and failover.
description.zh: 为网页搜索接入 Tavily，支持凭据存储、密钥轮换和失败切换。

description.en: Manage SDKs, AVDs and emulators, scaffold Kotlin/Compose projects, and build, install, inspect and operate Android apps.
description.zh: 管理 SDK、AVD 和模拟器，创建 Kotlin/Compose 工程，并构建、安装、检查和操作 Android 应用。

description.en: Expose Xcode project, simulator, build, install, launch, screenshot and log operations as native agent tools.
description.zh: 把 Xcode 工程、模拟器、构建、安装、运行、截图和日志操作接为原生 Agent 工具。

description.en: Share Markdown memory across coding agents, with automatic capture, retrieval and review of skill candidates.
description.zh: 在多个编程 Agent 间共享 Markdown 记忆，支持自动记录、检索和技能候选审阅。

description.en: Use local images or videos as backgrounds in the web and desktop interfaces.
description.zh: 为网页端和桌面端设置本地图片或视频背景。

description.en: Edit per-model reasoning levels, endpoint values, input modalities and token limits in Settings.
description.zh: 在设置页逐模型编辑推理档位、端点取值、输入模态和 Token 容量。

description.en: Compress conversation context while retaining history for subsequent work.
description.zh: 压缩会话上下文，保留后续工作需要的历史信息。

description.en: Check destructive commands and access to sensitive files before tool execution.
description.zh: 在工具执行前检查破坏性命令及对密钥等敏感文件的访问。

description.en: Provide a terminal coding interface and a staged /ship workflow for specifications, tests and acceptance.
description.zh: 提供终端编码界面，以及分阶段处理规格、测试和验收的 /ship 工作流。

description.en: Create persistent bots that coordinate through direct messages and group conversations.
description.zh: 创建持续运行的机器人，通过机器人间消息和群聊协作。

description.en: Manage selectable profiles with roles, personality, speaking style, rules and memory, with import/export and injection controls.
description.zh: 管理可切换的角色、性格、表达、准则和记忆配置，支持导入导出及注入开关。

description.en: Display balances across model providers and estimate session and subagent costs, including DeepSeek peak and off-peak pricing.
description.zh: 汇总多家模型供应商余额，估算会话与子 Agent 费用，并区分 DeepSeek 峰谷计价。

description.en: Check aquaculture input records, including required fields, withdrawal periods and harvest date intervals.
description.zh: 核对养殖投入品记录的字段、休药期与起捕日期间隔，提示记录差异。

description.en: Check archive registers for required fields, duplicate identifiers, retention terms and transfer dates.
description.zh: 核对档案台账的必填字段、重复档号、保管期限用词和移交日期。

description.en: Notify for approvals, questions and completed sessions with interactive cards, a desktop pet and browser wake recovery.
description.zh: 在审批、提问和会话完成时提醒，提供操作卡片、桌面宠物和浏览器唤醒重连。

description.en: Protect the web interface with passwords or shared tokens, session cookies and login rate limits.
description.zh: 为网页端添加口令或共享令牌认证、会话 Cookie、登录限速和用户管理命令。

description.en: Name sessions from the first message and stream title suggestions inside the rename dialog.
description.zh: 根据首条消息为会话命名，并在重命名弹窗中流式给出标题建议。

description.en: Configure multiple metered accounts or token plans and query their balances from one dashboard.
description.zh: 配置多个按量计费账号或 Token 套餐，在同一看板查询余额。

description.en: Validate storyboard JSON and render vertical promotional videos locally with Remotion.
description.zh: 校验分镜 JSON，并通过 Remotion 在本地渲染竖版宣传视频。

description.en: Connect playwright-mcp and peekaboo-mcp for browser and desktop control, with dependency setup and connection diagnostics.
description.zh: 接入 playwright-mcp 与 peekaboo-mcp 操控浏览器和桌面，提供依赖安装与连接诊断。

description.en: Create and preview CadQuery or ezdxf designs, and export STEP, STL or DXF using a local Python installation.
description.zh: 用本地 Python 的 CadQuery 或 ezdxf 建模预览，并导出 STEP、STL 或 DXF。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, skills and tools per session and inspect their context loading state.
description.zh: 按会话管理 MCP 服务器、技能和工具，查看它们在上下文中的加载状态。

description.en: Add a task dashboard, interactive content cards, downloads and workbenches for memory, capabilities, usage and media.
description.zh: 提供任务大盘、交互内容卡片和下载功能，以及记忆、能力、用量与媒体工作台。

description.en: Apply warm cream surfaces, terracotta accents, serif interface text and the Absolutely code palette.
description.zh: 采用暖米色界面、陶土橙强调色、宋体文字和 Absolutely 代码配色。

description.en: Browse a file tree and edit Markdown or text with tabs, preview, manual saving and drag-and-drop moves.
description.zh: 通过文件树和标签页编辑 Markdown 或文本，提供预览、手动保存和拖拽移动。

description.en: Quote selected text from chat, file previews or terminals, add comments and open side conversations or source locations.
description.zh: 引用对话、文件预览或终端中的选中文字，添加评论，打开侧边对话或跳回原文。

description.en: Ask an authenticated local AtomCode CLI for workspace-scoped advice or bounded code reviews with structured findings.
description.zh: 调用本机已登录的 AtomCode，进行按工作目录连续的侧边咨询或有界结构化代码评审。

description.en: Display ModelScope balance and request statistics, with optional registration of ModelScope models as a provider.
description.zh: 显示魔搭余额和调用统计，并可选择将魔搭模型注册为模型提供方。

description.en: Import free models from a local opencode serve catalog while keeping tool execution in DSH.
description.zh: 从本机 opencode serve 目录导入免费模型，并将工具执行留在 DSH。

description.en: Run code in subprocesses and return concise results, or index long material in local SQLite FTS5 for search.
description.zh: 在子进程执行代码并返回精简结果，或把长材料存入本地 SQLite FTS5 供检索。

description.en: Replace the compaction summarizer with a five-section handoff and keep compressed messages readable through a segmented directory.
description.zh: 把压缩摘要改为五段式交接文档，并通过分段目录保留被压缩消息的阅读入口。

description.en: Preview conversation deletion and optional linked-memory cleanup, with a recycle bin, audit log and per-session rollback.
description.zh: 预览会话及可选关联记忆的清理范围，提供回收站、审计日志和逐会话回滚。

description.en: Manage CLIProxyAPI accounts, balances, check-ins and tasks, with automatic CPA startup and shutdown.
description.zh: 管理 CLIProxyAPI 账号、余额、签到与任务，并让 CPA 随 DSH 启停。

description.en: Track provider balances, plan quotas, session costs and spending across time ranges.
description.zh: 查看供应商余额、套餐额度、会话费用和不同时间范围的累计消耗。

title.zh: 自定义 CSS 与壁纸

description.en: Edit custom CSS or configure wallpapers from the General settings page.
description.zh: 在通用设置中编辑自定义 CSS，或通过面板设置壁纸。

description.en: Check overdue days against dates and free periods, and compare declared charges with days multiplied by rates.
description.zh: 按日期与免箱期核对超期天数，并比较填报费用与天数乘费率的结果。

description.en: Configure and reorder desktop status fields, with token costs, custom model prices, currencies and account balance.
description.zh: 配置和排序桌面状态字段，显示 Token 费用、自定义模型单价、币种和账户余额。

description.en: Show the DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer and configure it from the plugin page.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在插件页配置显示方式。

description.en: Register machines and delegate tasks to one or more of them through ACP-backed agent tools.
description.zh: 登记机器后，通过基于 ACP 的 Agent 工具向一台或多台机器派发任务。

description.en: Check rubric fields, evidence locations, per-item score limits and agreement between item scores and totals.
description.zh: 核对评分项、原文定位、单项分值上限，以及各项得分与总分的算术一致性。

description.en: Apply six Everforest light and dark palettes with three contrast levels and per-browser persistence.
description.zh: 提供六套 Everforest 明暗配色与三档对比度，并按浏览器保存选择。

description.en: Run role-based subagents in parallel with per-role model and reasoning settings and a task sidebar.
description.zh: 并行运行按角色配置的子 Agent，为各角色设置模型与思考深度，并提供任务侧栏。

description.en: Convert Markdown to inline-styled WeChat articles, with themes, a sidebar workbench and block editing tools.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 排成带内联样式的公众号文章，提供主题、侧边工作台和块级改稿工具。

description.en: Notify for approvals, questions, plan review and completed replies, accounting for window focus and background sessions.
description.zh: 根据窗口焦点和后台会话状态，提醒审批、提问、方案确认与回复完成。

description.en: Publish generated HTML or Markdown to GitHub Pages and manage previously published artifacts.
description.zh: 将生成的 HTML 或 Markdown 发布到 GitHub Pages，并管理已发布产物。

description.en: Import binaries and run decompilation and output operations through persistent PyGhidra and GhidraMCP servers.
description.zh: 通过持久运行的 PyGhidra 与 GhidraMCP 服务导入二进制、反编译并输出结果。

description.en: Manage forge accounts and project authorization, then supply HTTPS credentials through a helper and reject unauthorized hosts.
description.zh: 管理代码托管账号和项目授权，通过 Helper 提供 HTTPS 凭据，并拒绝未授权主机。

description.en: Discover Grok models and run image, video and speech generation with durable local media tasks.
description.zh: 发现 Grok 模型，执行图片、视频和语音生成，并在本地持久化媒体任务。

description.en: Summarize running, approval, completion and scheduled-task states on collapsed sidebar groups, with counts and hover details.
description.zh: 在收起的侧栏分组上汇总运行、审批、完成和定时任务状态，显示数量与悬停明细。

description.en: Connect Kimi models to native DSH sessions and choose an embedded Kimi core or DSH execution per model.
description.zh: 在原生 DSH 会话中接入 Kimi 模型，按模型选择内嵌 Kimi 核心或 DSH 执行方式。

description.en: Check worksheet fields and consistency between process parameters, guide words and declared deviations.
description.zh: 核对 HAZOP 表的要素，以及工艺参数、引导词与所填偏差的一致性。

description.en: Load a Herta persona preset with memory and voice tools, bundled voice clips and character-specific conversation views.
description.zh: 加载黑塔角色预设，提供记忆与语音工具、随包语音及专属对话视图。

description.en: Search conversations within projects, read rendered history and export session content locally.
description.zh: 按项目搜索会话、阅读渲染后的历史内容，并在本地导出对话。

description.en: Check chapter, heading and subheading prefixes against declared commodity codes, reporting structural differences.
description.zh: 核对章、品目、子目与商品编号的前缀和层级关系，提示结构差异。

description.en: Record sessions in Hypatia and recall relevant material for later conversations.
description.zh: 自动把会话记录进 Hypatia，并在后续对话中召回相关内容。

description.en: Compact sessions when context exceeds a token threshold and user inactivity reaches the configured duration.
description.zh: 上下文超过 Token 阈值且用户空闲达到配置时长后，自动压缩会话。

description.en: Display background task progress, processing speed and estimated remaining time in a floating panel.
description.zh: 在悬浮面板中显示后台任务进度、处理速度和预计剩余时间。

description.en: Edit and search notes, tasks and documents, with tables, attachments, export and agent collaboration.
description.zh: 编辑和搜索笔记、待办与文档，支持表格、附件、导出和 Agent 协作。

description.en: Block Git commands inside Jujutsu workspaces and suggest the corresponding jj commands.
description.zh: 在 Jujutsu 工作区中阻止 Git 命令，并提示对应的 jj 命令。

description.en: Search and read local ZIM collections through a user-run kiwix-serve service, and list available books.
description.zh: 通过自行运行的 kiwix-serve 搜索和阅读本地 ZIM 资料，并列出可用书库。

description.en: Generate or edit images with Labnana and view subscription balances and estimated credit use.
description.zh: 通过 Labnana 生成或编辑图片，并查看订阅余额和积分用量估算。

description.en: Schedule reminders or delayed messages from commands and a panel, with delivery handled by the host.
description.zh: 通过命令或面板安排提醒和延迟消息，由宿主负责到时投递。

description.en: Show DeepSeek session costs and balance alongside Grok weekly quota, keeping gateway credentials in the host.
description.zh: 显示 DeepSeek 会话费用与余额、Grok 本周剩余额度，网关凭据保存在宿主端。

description.en: Manage LobsterAI accounts from a draggable floating panel, with built-in balance, check-in and account-switching controls.
description.zh: 通过可拖动悬浮面板管理 LobsterAI 账号，提供内置余额查询、签到和账号切换。

description.en: Authorize a browser-local directory and let agent tools read or write it through a private WebSocket relay.
description.zh: 在浏览器授权本地目录，通过私有 WebSocket 通道让 Agent 工具读写其中的文件。

description.en: Inspect and edit profile MCP servers, manage connections and add servers from the official registry.
description.zh: 查看和编辑 Profile 中的 MCP 服务器，管理连接并从官方目录添加服务器。

description.en: Parse pasted or imported MCP configurations, preview risk notes and write selected servers into the current profile.
description.zh: 解析粘贴或导入的 MCP 配置，预览风险提示，把选定服务器写入当前 Profile。

description.en: Render Mermaid diagrams on demand, follow the current theme and open a fullscreen zoom viewer.
description.zh: 按需渲染 Mermaid 图表，适配当前主题，并提供全屏缩放查看。

description.en: Build usage and estimated-spend views from session event logs, with model, time, project and conversation filters.
description.zh: 从会话事件日志汇总用量与费用估算，支持按模型、时间、项目和会话筛选。

description.en: Import provider models, fill missing metadata from models.dev and override model fields or pricing.
description.zh: 导入供应商模型，从 models.dev 补充缺失参数，并覆盖模型字段或计价设置。

description.en: Configure capabilities, plugins and system prompts per mode, with previews, version history and approval-gated prompt editing.
description.zh: 按模式配置能力、插件和系统提示词，提供预览、历史版本与需审批的提示词编辑。

description.en: Parse motor design requirements and filter candidate parameters for downstream calculation tools.
description.zh: 解析电机设计需求，初筛候选参数并生成后续计算工具所需数据。

description.en: Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg backgrounds with embedded video, scheduled switching, blur and a local rotation library.
description.zh: 加载 Wallpaper Engine 的 .mpkg 背景，支持内嵌视频、时段切换、虚化和本地轮换库。

description.en: Send native desktop notifications or webhooks when tasks complete, fail or wait for confirmation.
description.zh: 在任务完成、失败或等待确认时发送桌面原生通知或 Webhook 消息。

description.en: Check application structure and potential identity disclosures in document text and metadata using supplied rosters and rules.
description.zh: 依据提供的名单和规则，核对基金申请结构及正文、文档属性中的潜在身份泄露。

description.en: Use an authenticated Claude Code CLI as a model provider, forwarding sessions, approvals and image input.
description.zh: 把已登录的 Claude Code CLI 接为模型提供方，转发会话、审批和图片输入。

description.en: Configure the OpenViking memory plugin, diagnose connections and tune session recall scope and injection settings.
description.zh: 配置 OpenViking 记忆插件、诊断连接，并调整会话召回范围和注入参数。

description.en: Manage novel outlines, characters, annotations and review workflows with writing presets and a local Python backend.
description.zh: 管理小说大纲、人物、正文批注和审稿流程，提供创作预设及本地 Python 后端。

description.en: Provide Bash, PowerShell 7 and Rust-based command tools for DSH on Windows.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供 Bash、PowerShell 7 和 Rust 命令工具。

description.en: Parse documents with MinerU cloud or self-hosted providers, using background jobs, cached results and shared requests.
description.zh: 通过 MinerU 云端或自托管服务解析文档，支持后台任务、产物缓存和请求合并。

description.en: Notify for approvals, questions, completed work and errors through desktop alerts, sounds, title markers and webhooks.
description.zh: 通过桌面通知、声音、标题标记和 Webhook 提醒审批、提问、任务完成及错误。

description.en: Inspect plugin runtime behavior and distinguish live configuration changes, restarts and hot reloads.
description.zh: 诊断插件运行状态，区分实时配置生效、重启和热重载。

description.en: Chat with DSH sessions through Discord messages or threads and answer approvals or questions from either interface.
description.zh: 通过 Discord 私信或线程连接 DSH 会话，并可在任一界面回答审批或提问。

description.en: Route the pwsh tool to PowerShell 7 on Windows, with status, diagnostics and portable installation controls.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上把 pwsh 工具路由到 PowerShell 7，并提供状态、诊断和便携安装入口。

description.en: Discover DSH plugins on GitHub, inspect trust and compatibility evidence, and install through the official installer.
description.zh: 从 GitHub 发现 DSH 插件，检查可信度与兼容性证据，再通过官方安装器安装。

description.en: Review dependency advisories and static behavior evidence; automatic disabling requires a reviewed malicious finding.
description.zh: 审查依赖漏洞和插件行为证据，仅在有高置信度恶意审读结论时自动停用。

description.en: Encode a plugin set as a share code or QR code that others can import and install item by item.
description.zh: 把插件组合生成分享码或二维码，供他人导入后逐项安装。

description.en: Aggregate tokens and reference costs by time and model, with filters, cache statistics and configurable token prices.
description.zh: 按时间和模型汇总 Token 与参考成本，支持筛选、缓存统计和自定义 Token 单价。

description.en: Connect Postiz over MCP to inspect channels and posting rules, manage drafts and publish immediately or on schedule.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 连接 Postiz，查询渠道与发帖规则、管理草稿，并立即或定时发布。

description.en: Recalculate energy loss, loss rates and meter totals, reporting arithmetic differences against declared figures.
description.zh: 重算线损电量、线损率和计量点合计，提示与填报数值的算术差异。

description.en: Create, edit, inspect and export presentations, reverse existing decks and use bundled design systems and templates.
description.zh: 创建、编辑、检查和导出演示文稿，逆向已有文件，并使用随包设计系统与模板。

description.en: Edit personas, prompt sections and tool descriptions per preset, select tools and skills, and import or export JSON/YAML.
description.zh: 逐预设编辑人设、提示词段和工具描述，选择工具与技能，并导入导出 JSON 或 YAML。

description.en: Explain the consequences of extra-permission requests in full-access mode, with confidence and inspection scope.
description.zh: 在完全权限下分析额外授权请求的影响，并标注置信度与已检查范围。

description.en: Translate supported DSH prompts, edit them per profile and inspect exact-version matching while retaining tool and parameter names.
description.zh: 翻译和编辑支持的 DSH 提示词，按 Profile 保存并检查版本匹配，保留工具名与参数名。

description.en: Combine PTC coding mode, Cordis tools and preset-authoring skills in switchable agent presets.
description.zh: 把 PTC 编码模式、Cordis 工具和预设编写技能组合为可切换的 Agent 预设。

description.en: Explore usage and estimated costs across sessions, including model trends, heatmaps, quotas, balance reconciliation and CSV export.
description.zh: 查看跨会话用量与费用估算，提供模型趋势、热力图、配额、余额对账和 CSV 导出。

description.en: Orchestrate local subagents with task dependencies, execution states, isolated sessions and stage checks.
description.zh: 在单机上编排子 Agent，管理任务依赖、执行状态、会话隔离和阶段检查。

description.en: Install a pinned rea-agents release locally, start its MCP service and upgrade through an update control.
description.zh: 在本地安装指定版本的 rea-agents、启动其 MCP 服务，并通过更新入口升级。

description.en: Access sessions, approvals and files from mobile clients through a token gateway, with server switching and offline chat caching.
description.zh: 通过令牌网关从移动客户端访问会话、审批和文件，支持服务器切换及聊天离线缓存。

description.en: Restart the Windows desktop app through a detached helper, with confirmation, delay and executable path settings.
description.zh: 通过独立助手重启 Windows 桌面端，可设置确认、延时和目标程序路径。

description.en: Organize sourced company and job research, verify registered entities and generate evidence-bounded reports and interview questions.
description.zh: 整理公司与岗位来源证据，核验登记主体，生成有证据边界的报告、核验清单和面试问题。

description.en: Attach selected conversation text to the next message as editable annotations, retaining source highlights and jump-back links.
description.zh: 把对话中的选中文字作为可编辑批注附到下一条消息，保留原文高亮和回跳入口。

description.en: Manage services and routes through a web console, with Cloudflare tunnels and password login.
description.zh: 通过网页控制台管理服务和路由，支持 Cloudflare 隧道与口令登录。

description.en: Extend session menus with unread status, information copying, IDE opening and deletion, plus status indicators and configurable actions.
description.zh: 扩展会话菜单的未读、信息复制、IDE 打开和删除操作，并提供状态点与动作开关。

description.en: Exchange coordination messages between independently started sessions in one workspace and flag potential write-scope conflicts.
description.zh: 让同一工作区内独立启动的会话互发协调消息，并提示可能的文件写入范围冲突。

description.en: Create local delivery reports from Git changes, test evidence and responsive interface checks.
description.zh: 根据 Git 变更、测试证据和响应式界面检查生成本地交付报告。

description.en: Open side conversations and annotate selected text beside the main chat.
description.zh: 在主对话旁打开侧边聊天，并为选中文字添加批注。

description.en: Browse and search local skills, read SKILL.md and record tool outcomes in a skill-failure ledger.
description.zh: 浏览和搜索本地技能、阅读 SKILL.md，并把工具结果记录到技能失效台账。

description.en: Browse commit graphs and diffs, stage or discard changes, amend commits and create repositories or pull requests through gh.
description.zh: 查看提交图与差异、暂存或丢弃改动、修补提交，并通过 gh 创建仓库或拉取请求。

description.en: Show account quota, subscription type and daily statistics in the session header, with refresh and error notices.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏显示账号额度、订阅类型与今日统计，支持刷新和异常提示。

description.en: Show clickable follow-up suggestions below replies and send a selected suggestion as a user message.
description.zh: 在回复下方显示可点击的后续建议，选中后作为用户消息发送。

description.en: Route tasks among model pools and manage context thresholds, delegation, forked backups and handoff documents.
description.zh: 在多个模型池之间派发任务，管理上下文阈值、委派、分叉备份和交接文档。

description.en: Provide typed yes/no decisions, classifications and scores through System One services and agent tools.
description.zh: 通过 System One 服务和 Agent 工具提供类型化的是非判断、分类与评分。

description.en: Manage projects, labels, priorities and recurring tasks, with natural-language capture, statistics, import/export and agent tools.
description.zh: 管理项目、标签、优先级和重复任务，支持自然语言添加、统计、导入导出及 Agent 工具。

description.en: Organize media projects and assets, then run TongFlow image, voice, music and video workflows on an embedded canvas.
description.zh: 按项目整理媒体素材，在内嵌画布中运行 TongFlow 图片、配音、音乐和视频流程。

description.en: Plan multi-agent tasks in isolated worktrees and merge results through review gates.
description.zh: 规划多代理任务，在隔离工作树中执行，并经审查门禁合并结果。

description.en: Browse, switch and rename conversation branches, or turn a branch into an independent session.
description.zh: 用树形视图浏览、切换和重命名会话分支，也可将分支转为独立会话。

description.en: List installed plugins' capabilities, prompt injections and install scripts with source locations.
description.zh: 列出已装插件的能力、提示词注入和安装脚本，并提供源码位置。

description.en: Expose a running tsm-core-dlr vector-and-graph service as MCP tools, with modeling skills and a service-status panel.
description.zh: 把运行中的 tsm-core-dlr 向量与图服务接为 MCP 工具，提供建模技能和服务状态面板。

title.zh: Gemini 与 Vertex AI 配置

description.en: Configure Gemini API and Vertex AI decoding, protocols and service tiers, and inspect responses, usage and estimated costs.
description.zh: 配置 Gemini API 与 Vertex AI 的解码、协议和服务等级，并检查响应、用量与费用估算。

description.en: Let agents offer voice calls; accept, reject or defer them, with local speech synthesis after acceptance.
description.zh: 让 Agent 发起语音来电，可接听、拒绝或稍后处理，接听后通过本地语音合成播放。

description.en: Provide streaming dictation, optional wake words, spoken replies, live captions and interruption when the user speaks.
description.zh: 提供流式听写、可选唤醒词、回复朗读与实时字幕，用户开口时可打断播放。

description.en: Deploy DSH to a VPS over SSH and manage its HTTPS gateway, service state and upgrades.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把 DSH 部署到 VPS，并管理 HTTPS 网关、服务状态和升级。

description.en: Manage registered VPS hosts over SSH, with terminals, status commands, confirmation gates and file backups.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 管理已登记的 VPS，提供终端、状态命令、操作确认和文件备份。

description.en: Add a Monaco editor and review agent edits with per-change acceptance, rejection and rollback.
description.zh: 提供 Monaco 文件编辑器，逐处审查、采纳或拒绝 Agent 修改，并支持回滚。

description.en: Add file browsing, Monaco editing, search and local Git controls to DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供文件浏览、Monaco 编辑器、搜索和本地 Git 操作面板。

description.en: Search through Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and Tinyfish, with per-session connection and freshness preferences.
description.zh: 集成 Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily 和 Tinyfish，支持会话级搜索连接与时效偏好。

description.en: Edit web plugin sources, preview changes and run patch checks and builds from a workbench.
description.zh: 在工作台编辑网页插件源码、预览改动，并运行补丁检查和构建。

description.en: Send WeCom group-bot messages for approvals, questions, completed tasks, blocked goals and errors.
description.zh: 通过企业微信群机器人提醒审批、提问、任务完成、目标阻塞和错误。

description.en: Arrange session statistics, tasks, context, heatmaps, references and quota widgets in a configurable sidebar grid.
description.zh: 在可配置侧边网格中排列会话统计、任务、上下文、热力图、引用和额度部件。

description.en: Connect WorkBuddy desktop models through the Functy fork, with a dashboard, account rotation and quota display.
description.zh: 通过 Functy 分支接入 WorkBuddy 桌面模型，提供仪表盘、账号轮换和额度显示。

description.en: Register a WorkBuddy model provider and manage account quotas, daily check-ins, rate-limit cooldowns and switching.
description.zh: 注册 WorkBuddy 模型提供方，管理账号额度、每日签到、限流冷却和切换。

description.en: Use models from a Zed AI subscription through Zed Cloud and configure their credentials in DSH.
description.zh: 通过 Zed Cloud 使用 Zed AI 订阅提供的模型，并在 DSH 中配置凭据。

description.en: Provide a mobile interface and pairing gateway, with installable PWA and push notifications through your proxy or tunnel.
description.zh: 提供移动界面和配对网关，通过自建反代或隧道使用可安装、带推送的 PWA。

description.en: Connect FitMeet through per-user OAuth for people, activities, reminders, messages and previewed writes.
description.zh: 通过独立用户 OAuth 接入 FitMeet，处理找人、活动、提醒、消息和带预览的写入。

description.en: Connect TokenDance through OAuth, control catalog visibility and expose chat, media generation and typed decision tools.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 接入 TokenDance，控制模型目录显隐，提供对话、媒体生成和类型化判断工具。

description.en: Control Windows apps through window targets, UI Automation, screenshots and verified input, with an isolated Chromium option.
description.zh: 通过窗口目标、UIA、截图和输入验证操控 Windows 应用，并可使用隔离的 Chromium。
